title: Projekt-Scope: ein Schalter, ein Klick zu allen Projekten
summary: Operator-Befund 12.09.2026: die Sicht „Alle Projekte“ wird oft benutzt, braucht aber zwei Klicks; Kopfzeile (Projekt-Pill mit eingebettetem Auto-Pickup-Schalter und Parallelität) und Explorer-Kopf (Rasterknopf „All projects“) sind zwei Bedienelemente mit verschiedener Optik, und ein Effekt setzt den Scope beim Tab-Wechsel still neu. Sechs Anforderungen, drei Alternativen mit Mockups (A Segment „Alle | Projekt“ in der Kopfzeile mit getrenntem Status-Chip, B Explorer als einziger Besitzer, C nur Tastenkürzel), Empfehlung A in zwei Schritten, Entscheidungen D1 Bedienelement, D2 Scope beim Tab-Wechsel, D3 Platz des Auto-Pickup-Schalters, Karten K1/K2.

implementationTasks.title: Project scope: one control in the title bar (All | Project segment), separate auto-pickup status chip with menu, explorer shows the scope, keyboard shortcuts (operator decisions D1-D3)
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the alternative selected in docs/operations/projekt-scope-schalter/index.html (decisions D1 to D3). For the recommended A: replace the project picker pill in studio-titlebar with a segment control 'All | <project> ▾' where the left part switches to the workspace-wide scope with one click and back to the last project with one click, the right part opens the existing project dropdown; move the auto-pickup toggle and the parallelism count out of the pill into a separate status chip (mode dot, mode label, running/parallelism such as 3/8, aggregate for All) whose click opens a small menu Auto / Paused / Manual instead of toggling blindly, with a tooltip naming mode, runner and numbers; replace the grid button 'All projects' in the explorer sidebar header with a read-only scope line using the same glyph and tokens that focuses the segment on click; add Ctrl+Shift+A (All / back) and Ctrl+Shift+P (picker) and list both in the command palette; below 900 px collapse the segment to glyph plus caret. Apply D2: if 'scope holds' was selected, change the tab effect in app.ts so an explicitly chosen scope is not overwritten by tab activation and tabs show their project context as a chip in the tab and the view header; if 'follow' was selected keep the effect; if 'ask' was selected implement the one-time dialog with a persisted preference. Keep all data-testids that specs rely on and add testids for segment, chip, menu and scope line. Evidence: screenshots of title bar and explorer in both scope states, light and dark, at 1536 and 900 px; an E2E test proving one click to All and one click back; component specs for segment, chip menu and scope line; changelog entry.
